text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Then, moving on with the textbook... Buena 
Vista-san, please go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Y-Yes. '...Melos, strike me. Strike my 
cheek with a sound just as loud—'"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"‘Just once... for a fleeting moment, I 
doubted you. ...*sniff*... For the first 
time in my life... I doubted you...!’"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"If only... you hadn't hit me...!" Ugh... 
I-I'm sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista ended up crying over a 
textbook. Causing worry for her teacher 
and classmates, she felt terribly 
apologetic...
